preconditions.description: The number of rows in the city grid is between 2 and 2000.
The number of columns in the city grid is between 2 and 2000.
The time Dima moves between unoccupied cells is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: a_{ij} in {-1, 0, x} for all i, j where -1 <= a_{ij} <= 10^9
preconditions.description: Each cell in the city grid is either prohibited (-1), free (0), or contains a portal (x).
The starting cell (1, 1) and the destination cell (n, m) are free.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if Dima cannot reach the school, or the minimum time to reach the school.
